fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurl a ball of fire at your enemy, dealing fire damage.
fireball.visual_effect: A blazing sphere of flame streaks toward your target.
fireball.lore: The most basic yet essential spell in every fire mage's arsenal.

ice_shard.name: Ice Shard
ice_shard.description: Launch a shard of ice that pierces and slows your enemy.
ice_shard.visual_effect: A crystalline spike of ice flies through the air.
ice_shard.lore: Frost mages learn this spell to control the battlefield.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.description: Strike your foe with a bolt of pure lightning.
lightning_bolt.visual_effect: A crackling arc of electricity leaps from your fingertips.
lightning_bolt.lore: The raw power of the storm, channeled through a mage's will.

heal.name: Heal
heal.description: Restore health to yourself or an ally.
heal.visual_effect: Warm golden light envelops the target, mending wounds.
heal.lore: The foundation of all healing magic.

shield.name: Arcane Shield
shield.description: Surround yourself with a protective magical barrier.
shield.visual_effect: Shimmering blue energy forms a dome around you.
shield.lore: Every mage should know how to protect themselves.

flame_wall.name: Wall of Flames
flame_wall.description: Create a wall of fire that damages enemies who pass through.
flame_wall.visual_effect: A towering wall of flames erupts from the ground.
flame_wall.lore: A defensive spell that turns the battlefield into an inferno.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.description: Summon a freezing blizzard that damages and slows all enemies in an area.
blizzard.visual_effect: Snow and ice swirl violently, obscuring vision.
blizzard.lore: The power of winter's wrath, concentrated into a single spell.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.description: Lightning arcs between multiple enemies, damaging each.
chain_lightning.visual_effect: Electricity jumps from foe to foe in a deadly chain.
chain_lightning.lore: A devastating spell when facing multiple adversaries.

greater_heal.name: Greater Heal
greater_heal.description: Restore a large amount of health to yourself or an ally.
greater_heal.visual_effect: Brilliant golden light surrounds the target, rapidly healing wounds.
greater_heal.lore: Advanced healing magic that can save lives in dire situations.

mass_heal.name: Mass Heal
mass_heal.description: Heal all allies in your party.
mass_heal.visual_effect: Waves of healing energy radiate outward, touching everyone nearby.
mass_heal.lore: A lifesaving spell that can turn the tide of battle.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.description: Instantly transport yourself to a known location.
teleport.visual_effect: You shimmer and fade, reappearing elsewhere.
teleport.lore: Master the fabric of space itself with this spell.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.description: Become invisible for a short time.
invisibility.visual_effect: Your form becomes transparent, fading from view.
invisibility.lore: Bend light around yourself to disappear from sight.

summon_familiar.name: Summon Familiar
summon_familiar.description: Summon a magical creature to fight by your side.
summon_familiar.visual_effect: A portal opens and a small magical beast emerges.
summon_familiar.lore: Every summoner's first companion from the astral plane.

meteor_strike.name: Meteor Strike
meteor_strike.description: Call down a meteor from the sky to devastate an area.
meteor_strike.visual_effect: A burning boulder descends from the heavens with tremendous force.
meteor_strike.lore: One of the most destructive spells known to mages.

frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.description: Freeze all enemies around you in place.
frost_nova.visual_effect: A burst of frost emanates from your body in all directions.
frost_nova.lore: A defensive spell that gives you space to escape or reposition.

thunder_storm.name: Thunder Storm
thunder_storm.description: Summon a violent storm that strikes enemies with lightning repeatedly.
thunder_storm.visual_effect: Dark clouds gather overhead, unleashing bolt after bolt of lightning.
thunder_storm.lore: Channel the fury of a thunderstorm against your foes.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.description: Bring a fallen ally back to life with full health.
resurrection.visual_effect: Divine light descends, reforming the target's body and restoring their soul.
resurrection.lore: The pinnacle of healing magic, defying death itself.

time_stop.name: Time Stop
time_stop.description: Stop time for everyone but yourself, allowing free action.
time_stop.visual_effect: Everything freezes in place as time itself halts.
time_stop.lore: Bend the fabric of time itself - use with extreme caution.

arcane_missiles.name: Arcane Missiles
arcane_missiles.description: Fire multiple bolts of pure arcane energy at your target.
arcane_missiles.visual_effect: Purple missiles of energy streak toward your enemy.
arcane_missiles.lore: A reliable spell that never misses its mark.

mana_shield.name: Mana Shield
mana_shield.description: Convert incoming damage to mana loss instead of health loss.
mana_shield.visual_effect: A shimmering barrier of pure mana surrounds you.
mana_shield.lore: Trade mana for survival - a worthy exchange in dire times.

fear.name: Fear
fear.description: Strike terror into an enemy's heart, causing them to flee.
fear.visual_effect: Dark shadows crawl across your target's vision.
fear.lore: Sometimes the greatest weapon is your enemy's own mind.

charm.name: Charm
charm.description: Make an enemy fight on your side temporarily.
charm.visual_effect: Your target's eyes glaze over as they fall under your influence.
charm.lore: Turn your enemies against each other with this powerful enchantment.

summon_elemental.name: Summon Elemental
summon_elemental.description: Summon a powerful elemental to fight for you.
summon_elemental.visual_effect: Raw elemental energy coalesces into a formidable creature.
summon_elemental.lore: Command the primal forces of nature themselves.

dispel_magic.name: Dispel Magic
dispel_magic.description: Remove magical effects from a target.
dispel_magic.lore: Counter enemy magic or cleanse harmful enchantments.

haste.name: Haste
haste.description: Speed up time for an ally, doubling their movement and attack speed.
haste.visual_effect: Your target blurs as they move at incredible speed.
haste.lore: Time itself bends to your will, granting supernatural speed.

drain_life.name: Drain Life
drain_life.description: Drain life from an enemy, healing yourself for the damage dealt.
drain_life.visual_effect: Dark tendrils leech vitality from your foe.
drain_life.lore: Feed on your enemy's life force to sustain yourself.

raise_dead.name: Raise Dead
raise_dead.description: Animate corpses to fight as undead minions.
raise_dead.visual_effect: The dead rise from the ground, animated by dark magic.
raise_dead.lore: Command the dead to serve you in battle.

holy_light.name: Holy Light
holy_light.description: Smite undead and demons with pure divine energy.
holy_light.visual_effect: Brilliant white light sears through unholy creatures.
holy_light.lore: The light of righteousness burns away darkness.

divine_wrath.name: Divine Wrath
divine_wrath.description: Call down divine judgment on all enemies in an area.
divine_wrath.visual_effect: Pillars of holy fire descend from the heavens.
divine_wrath.lore: Invoke the wrath of the gods themselves.

stone_skin.name: Stone Skin
stone_skin.description: Turn your skin to stone, greatly increasing defense.
stone_skin.visual_effect: Your skin takes on a rocky, impenetrable texture.
stone_skin.lore: Become as immovable and indestructible as a mountain.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.description: Transform an enemy into a harmless creature temporarily.
polymorph.visual_effect: Your target shimmers and transforms into a sheep.
polymorph.lore: A humiliating and effective way to neutralize threats.

mirror_image.name: Mirror Image
mirror_image.description: Create illusory duplicates of yourself to confuse enemies.
mirror_image.visual_effect: Multiple copies of you appear, indistinguishable from the original.
mirror_image.lore: Let your enemies waste their attacks on phantoms.

black_tentacles.name: Black Tentacles
black_tentacles.description: Summon writhing tentacles of darkness that grab and crush enemies.
black_tentacles.visual_effect: Dark tentacles erupt from the ground, grasping at anything nearby.
black_tentacles.lore: Call forth eldritch horrors from the void.

prismatic_spray.name: Prismatic Spray
prismatic_spray.description: Unleash a cone of multicolored magical energy with random effects.
prismatic_spray.visual_effect: A rainbow of chaotic magical energy sprays forth.
prismatic_spray.lore: Raw, unpredictable magic - devastating but dangerous.

power_word_kill.name: Power Word: Kill
power_word_kill.description: Speak a word of death that instantly kills a weakened target.
power_word_kill.visual_effect: You utter a single word and your target collapses, lifeless.
power_word_kill.lore: The ultimate execution - a single word that ends life itself.
